lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Posterior to the gill slits, high-intensity circular blobs are arranged in a structured grid. A central column consists of three vertically aligned spots, followed posteriorly by a column of three larger, vertically elongated spots, forming a localized rectangular constellation.
